company.name: Gleef
company.shortDescription: Gleef is an AI-powered SaaS for B2B that enhances and standardizes copywriting in digital products, replacing localization software.
company.description: Gleef optimizes words in digital products through contextualized translation, brand-identity-tailored suggestions, and the ability to conduct A/B tests of copy, all without requiring developers' involvement.
